cluster_summary: This cluster covers vulnerabilities where error pages incorporate user-controllable data (error messages, stack traces, query parameters) into HTML responses without proper output encoding, leading to cross-site scripting or information disclosure, as well as a memory exhaustion issue from unbounded caching of attacker-influenced error pages.
guideline_text: Trace attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters into template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators. Report code paths where untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features. Confirm that the required guard is enforced on the same source-to-sink path before the sensitive effect. Treat this as a reusable mechanism-level pattern derived from 1 historical CVE example(s), not as a project-specific signature. A safe implementation should separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input.

mechanism.missing_guard: untrusted expression content is evaluated without sandboxing, escaping, allowlisting, or disabling reflective execution features
mechanism.name: untrusted template or expression evaluation
mechanism.sink_shape: template engines, expression evaluators, macro renderers, or scriptable configuration evaluators
mechanism.source_shape: attacker-controlled template text, expression strings, macro content, or rendering parameters
mechanism.typical_fix: separate data from templates, sandbox expression evaluation, and disable reflection or method invocation features for untrusted input

sub_patterns.fix_strategy: Apply HTML escaping to the data (e.g., using StringEscapeUtils.escapeHtml4 or HtmlEscapers) before inserting it into the HTML template.
sub_patterns.name: Missing HTML escaping of user-controllable error content leading to XSS
sub_patterns.root_cause: User-controlled data (error messages or exception stack traces) is embedded directly into an HTML response without HTML entity encoding, allowing injection of arbitrary HTML/JavaScript.
